name: ReviewsJet
author: FlexByt, Inc.

sections.description:
Are you looking for a way to display reviews on your website? Look no further.

Display up to 15 reviews and upgrade only if satisfied.

Features:

1. Reviews Management

  • Collect more reviews using a spin wheel
  • Create and share review images
  • Collect reviews from Google, Yelp, Etsy, Amazon, AliExpress, Airbnb, Tripadvisor, Trustpilot, Product Hunt, etc.
  • Upload existing reviews using an Excel sheet
  • Set up an after-purchase email and watch your reviews flow in
  • Send targeted emails to customers for valuable reviews
  • Enjoy the convenience of auto-publishing reviews

2. Clean Widgets

  • Wall of Love: Choose from Masonry or Grid styles for visually appealing displays
  • Carousel: Engage users with Marquee or Slider options for interactive presentations
  • Modal Widget: Showcase a review sticker on every page, revealing a modal with all user reviews
  • Product Reviews Widget: Tailored for stores, gather and display product reviews with user-submitted pictures

3. Automated Review Requests

  • Easily trigger review requests following every checkout for seamless feedback collection

Development

The ReviewsJet plugin uses several build tools to optimize the production code. The uncompressed source code for all minified files can be found in our public repository:

Source Code:
– GitHub Repository: https://github.com/FlexByt/modal-widget
– Development Documentation: README.md

External Services

This plugin connects to ReviewsJet’s services to manage and display customer reviews. The following external services are used:

1. ReviewsJet Authentication Service (app.reviewsjet.com)

  • Purpose: Handles user authentication and account management
  • Data sent: Email, website URL, and authentication tokens
  • When: During login, registration, and when accessing ReviewsJet dashboard features
  • Privacy Policy: https://reviewsjet.com/privacy-policy
  • Terms of Service: https://reviewsjet.com/terms

2. ReviewsJet API Service (api.reviewsjet.com)

  • Purpose: Fetches and manages review data, widget configurations, and site settings
  • Data sent:
    • Site ID and authentication tokens for API requests
    • Widget configuration preferences
    • Review data when importing from external sources
  • When:
    • When widgets are displayed on your site
    • When importing or managing reviews
    • When customizing widget appearance
  • Privacy Policy: https://reviewsjet.com/privacy-policy
  • Terms of Service: https://reviewsjet.com/terms

All data transmission is secured using industry-standard encryption (HTTPS/SSL). ReviewsJet services are hosted on DigitalOcean’s infrastructure in the SFO3 (San Francisco) region.

For more information about how ReviewsJet handles your data, please visit our Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Create an account or log in to ReviewsJet from the plugin settings.
  4. Use the shortcodes to display review widgets on your pages.
sections.faq:
How do I display reviews on my website?

Simply copy the provided shortcodes to any page or post after logging in.

Is ReviewsJet free?

ReviewsJet offers both free and premium plans. Visit ReviewsJet Pricing to learn more.
